fixtures: NONE; no business, audit, credential, payment or attendance rows may be created
isolation: Existing disposable target is a conditional catalogue-only pilot target; full executor/concurrency acceptance requires separately approved isolation and sequence/recovery scope
transaction: One fresh client connection, one BEGIN, one terminal ROLLBACK, no intermediate transaction boundaries
post_verification: Required separate fresh identity-guarded read-only original-baseline verification and exact before/after sequence state comparison; never infer success from ROLLBACK text alone
